# Requirements Quality Checklist: Backlog vinculado de qualquer worktree

**Purpose**: Validar completude, clareza, consistência e mensurabilidade dos requisitos de resolução do backlog por conjunto de worktrees, alvo de vínculo novo, recusa por ambiguidade e degradação, antes de `tasks`
**Created**: 2026-09-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/](../contracts/)
**Depth**: Standard · **Audience**: revisor do ciclo v4 (etapas `analyze` e `review`)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the three resolution outcomes (`BOUND`, `NEEDS-BIND`, `NEEDS-CREATE`) each defined with the condition that produces them and the `bound_path` they carry? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003, contracts/backlog-resolution.md]
- [x] CHK002 Is the source of the worktree list specified, including the exact invocation shape and the ordering rule that identifies the control worktree? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, contracts/worktree-enumeration.md]
- [x] CHK003 Are the refusal conditions enumerated (ambiguity, requested code mismatch, requested code bound elsewhere) with the message each produces? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, data-model.md §Recusa]
- [x] CHK004 Is the degraded path specified for every failure mode of the enumeration (non-zero exit, empty output, no `worktree ` lines)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, contracts/worktree-enumeration.md]
- [x] CHK005 Are all callers that must share the resolution enumerated, so that "same result in any worktree" is checkable per verb? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, contracts/backlog-resolution.md]
- [x] CHK006 Are the eight version points the bump must touch enumerated, and is the bump magnitude fixed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, plan.md §Bump, research.md R7]
- [x] CHK007 Are the required test cases enumerated with the scenario each covers, including the one real-git case? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, plan.md §Testes]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 Is "corresponder a qualquer worktree registrada" defined as membership in a normalised set rather than string equality? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]
- [x] CHK009 Is "caminho real" defined operationally (realpath on both sides) so that symlink and spelling cases have one answer? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, research.md R6]
- [x] CHK010 Is "checkout principal" defined by a deterministic rule (first `worktree ` line) rather than by description? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities, contracts/worktree-enumeration.md]
- [x] CHK011 Is the `bound_path` reported for `BOUND` unambiguous when the vínculo points at a linked worktree (real vínculo path, not control)? [Clarity, Spec §US1-S3, contracts/backlog-resolution.md]
- [x] CHK012 Is "nomeando os códigos e caminhos" specified as a concrete message shape? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, data-model.md §Recusa]
- [x] CHK013 Is "no máximo uma vez por comando" defined at the level of the resolution call rather than per item? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, plan.md §Performance Goals]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK014 Do FR-005 (never re-point) and US2-S2 (bind new records control path) agree that only a *new* bind writes a path? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK015 Does the ambiguity refusal (FR-006) align with the existing "never silently rebind" rule and with the reuse of `BACKLOG-UNAVAILABLE` (FR-009)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK016 Is the degraded path (FR-007) consistent with the assumption that CLI callers never reach it because the root gate refuses first? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, research.md R3]
- [x] CHK017 Are the `bound_path` semantics in the spec (US1-S3, US2-S1) and in `contracts/backlog-resolution.md` the same for each status? [Consistency, Spec §US1, §US2, contracts/backlog-resolution.md]
- [x] CHK018 Does the plan's `worktree_candidates` invariant ("root always in the set") match FR-007's promise of current-behaviour fallback? [Consistency, plan.md §Enumeração, Spec §FR-007]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK019 Is SC-001 ("100% das worktrees") verifiable by a finite enumeration of the repository's worktrees? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK020 Is SC-003 ("lista idêntica antes/depois") tied to a concrete comparison artefact (`backlog list` output)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, quickstart.md §3]
- [x] CHK021 Is SC-005 ("nenhum código público muda de forma") backed by an enumerated list of the codes that must stay stable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, contracts/backlog-resolution.md §Invariantes]
- [x] CHK022 Can each acceptance scenario of US1..US3 be mapped to at least one planned test case? [Traceability, Spec §US1..US3, plan.md §Testes]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK023 Are requirements defined for the repository with a single worktree (no behaviour change)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK024 Are requirements defined for a vínculo pointing at a linked worktree that still exists (stays as is)? [Coverage, Spec §US1-S3, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK025 Are requirements defined for a vínculo pointing at a removed worktree (current behaviour, out of scope)? [Coverage, Spec §US3-S3, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK026 Are requirements defined for `requested` code interactions in every worktree (mismatch, bound elsewhere, unbound with matching name)? [Coverage, Spec §US2-S3, §US2-S4]
- [x] CHK027 Are recovery/rollback requirements intentionally excluded, given that resolution never mutates and bind is preview-first? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, contracts/backlog-resolution.md §Invariantes]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK028 Is the case of a worktree directory whose name collides with another repository's name addressed (name derived from control)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK029 Is the case of duplicate or symlinked paths in the git output addressed (dedupe after realpath)? [Edge Case, contracts/worktree-enumeration.md §Saída]
- [x] CHK030 Is the case of running outside a repository addressed as unchanged (refused before resolution)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements
